analysis: Valproic acid is known to have several side effects, including causing obesity, hirsutism, and neural tube defects. However, it is not classified as an enzyme inducer; rather, it is an enzyme inhibitor, particularly of the cytochrome P450 system. Therefore, the statement that it is an enzyme inducer is incorrect.
